senses.definition: Superlative form of new: most new.

quotes.text: This was definitely to be the station, one which would cater for all needs for years to come. But it was evident within the next few years that Johannesburg would once again outgrow its newest station.
quotes.reference: 1958 September 25, C. Alan Cook, “Johannesburg's Fourth Station”, in Railway Magazine, page 640:
